description: HWM14 estimates horizontal neutral winds through an empirical upper-atmosphere model family. Successive versions incorporate satellite and ground measurements to extend the altitude and observational coverage. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run, Public Repository, Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented implementation does not include solar-activity dependence and ignores its F107 arguments. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
